sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal proposal: 6306-2Z C3
move.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the offer and for sharing the cost drivers. We value the relationship and can commit our full requirement of 20,000 pieces per year for 24 months, in return for a competitive fixed price and extended payment terms.

Producer prices DE: bearings, gears, gearing and driving elements changed +0.8% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08). Our demand forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). Our recent orders were at EUR 4.39 to 4.39 (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).

Could you support EUR 4.40 per unit, 90 days net, for a 24-month term? If not, please share a cost breakdown and any lower-cost alternatives for us to review.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
We are willing to support your request for a 24-month agreement and extended payment terms of 90 days net, which allows us to offer a unit price of EUR 4.94.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that it is our company policy not to disclose internal cost structures.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal of 6306 framework agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for reviewing our proposal and for supporting a 24-month term with 90 days net. We understand your position on sharing internal cost details. To move towards renewal, we can improve our price proposal to EUR 4.48 per unit, while committing our full requirement of 20,000 pieces per year for 24 months and retaining 90 days net.

Could you confirm whether you can meet these terms, or share your best revised price and any lower-cost variant for our review?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your inquiry. We have carefully reviewed your request, but we cannot offer any further price reductions; therefore, EUR 4.94 is our final offer. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is valid for 7 days.

For your reference, our offer comprises a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Regarding your inquiry about a lower-cost variant, we do not have an alternative that meets your specifications.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
